data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Chart.js Visualizations
features.description: Implement data visualizations using Chart.js for various metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Visualize pipeline metrics, cost tracking, and success rates
Include line, bar, area, pie, and radar charts
Ensure charts are interactive and animated

features.title: Real-Time Metrics Dashboard
features.description: Showcase a real-time dashboard with various Chart.js graphs.
acceptance_criteria: Display LLM cost over time using a line chart
Show stage completion rates with a bar chart
Illustrate success rate trends using an area chart

features.title: Code Quality Metrics
features.description: Visualize code quality metrics such as TDD compliance and SOLID principles.
acceptance_criteria: Use a radar chart to display code quality metrics
Include metrics for TDD compliance and SOLID principles
Ensure data accuracy and clarity

features.title: Template Utilization
features.description: Leverage existing demo templates for creating the Artemis self-demo presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Use templates from specified directory: /home/bbrelin/src/repos/salesforce/slides/
Incorporate elements from contract_analytics_dashboard.html, lead_opportunity_intelligence_demo.html, and artemis_complete_demo.html
Ensure consistency with the original templates

features.title: Auto-Advance and Navigation
features.description: Enable slides to auto-advance with navigation controls.
acceptance_criteria: Implement auto-advance feature for slides
Provide navigation controls for manual slide progression
Ensure user-friendly navigation experience

features.title: Results Display
features.description: Showcase real metrics from recent runs with actual data.
acceptance_criteria: Display real metrics from recent Artemis runs
Ensure data is up-to-date and accurate
Present data in a clear and understandable format

features.title: Supervisor Integration Visualization
features.description: Demonstrate supervisor integration across stages using a pie chart.
acceptance_criteria: Create a pie chart to show supervisor integration
Ensure accurate representation of integration data
Include interactive elements for detailed insights

features.title: Standalone HTML File
features.description: Develop a single HTML file with embedded CSS, JavaScript, and Chart.js.
acceptance_criteria: Create a single HTML file with no external dependencies
Embed all necessary CSS and JavaScript within the HTML
Include Chart.js library for data visualization

features.title: Professional Design
features.description: Design a visually appealing presentation with gradients and smooth transitions.
acceptance_criteria: Use professional gradient backgrounds
Implement smooth slide transitions
Ensure overall design consistency and appeal
